message: the IR bytes are not well-formed JSON for this schema: V_detail
why: The loader decodes into a fixed shape. When a field has the wrong JSON type (an object where an integer was expected, a string where a list was expected), decoding stops at the first mismatch and nothing after it is checked — so this is the only diagnostic you get until it is fixed.
fix: fix the reported field; the surrounding IR is probably fine
or regenerate the artifact if it was hand-edited
